create_AsyncQueue: create an AsyncQueue instance with a StageInfo and buffer size for pipeline stage communication
create_StatsQueue: create a StatsQueue to measure put and get latency plus occupancy rate between pipeline stages
create_ThreadBasedAsyncQueue: create a ThreadBasedAsyncQueue backed by queue.Queue for low-latency cross-thread handoff between stages
set_default_queue_class: set the default queue class used when connecting pipeline stages via PipelineBuilder
get_default_queue_class: get the currently configured default queue class for pipeline stage connections
